notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. The only tower-specific source is the GA tower list. Two WebSearches (Danielsville Madison County fire lookout; Madison County GFC tower history) returned fire-department, fire-investigation and out-of-state tower pages, none about this tower. Possible lead, unverified: the Savannah Now article describes a Madison County tower near Ila that was moved to Walton County in 1973 (now the Fairwood Fire Tower). The article gives no coordinates and does not link it to the danielsville entry, so the two are kept apart here; check coordinates before merging. The list gives elevation (780) with no unit stated, so it is not used. Brief status, access and visit values are unsupported, so no facts keys are written. Next step if wanted: ask the GFC or Madison County whether a tower stood near 34.111, -83.193 and whether it was removed.
